shadow_samples.name: shadow_samples
shadow_samples.definition: select "reviews"."id" as "review_id", "changes"."repo_id" as "repo_id", "reviews"."change_id" as "change_id", "reviews"."head_sha" as "head_sha", "reviews"."computed_lane" as "computed_lane", "reviews"."human_lane" as "human_lane", "reviews"."decision" as "decision", "reviews"."created_at" as "created_at" from "reviews" inner join "changes" on "changes"."id" = "reviews"."change_id"
